description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the Execution Accuracy across four distinct categories for two different methods. The horizontal axis displays the categories, ordered from left to right as "Simple", "Moderate", "Challenging", and "Total", without an explicit axis label. The vertical axis is labeled "Execution Accuracy" and uses a linear scale with a visible range from 20 to 60, marked by tick intervals of 10 units. The data is presented in grouped bars, where each category contains two adjacent bars. A legend at the top indicates that the light blue bars represent "NatSQL", while the darker blue bars correspond to a second method whose text label is obscured by a gray rectangle. Every bar is visually emphasized with an exact numerical annotation above it. In the "Simple" group, the light blue bar reads 60.21 and the dark blue bar is 63.14, which is the tallest bar in the chart. For the "Moderate" group, the light blue and dark blue bars show values of 39.64 and 48.60, respectively. The "Challenging" group contains the shortest bar overall, with the light blue bar at 32.32, next to the dark blue bar at 36.11. Finally, the "Total" group displays 51.35 for the light blue bar and 56.19 for the dark blue bar. The categories are not sorted by numerical value, but rather follow a progression of apparent difficulty followed by an aggregate total.
